entry.title: SPECTRE presented at CVPR 2026
entry.content:
Cris Claessens and Christiaan Viviers presented SPECTRE at CVPR 2026 in Denver, Colorado.

SPECTRE (Self-Supervised & Cross-Modal Pretraining for CT Representation Extraction) is a transformer-based foundation model for volumetric CT imaging. It combines geometry-aware modelling with large-scale self-supervised and cross-modal pretraining to learn robust representations for downstream medical-imaging tasks.

The presentation was a great opportunity to share the work with the computer-vision community and discuss how foundation models can help advance scalable, reliable analysis of 3D medical images.

Read the LinkedIn updates from the presenters.

See the second LinkedIn post.
entry.summary: Cris Claessens and Christiaan Viviers presented SPECTRE at CVPR 2026 in Denver, Colorado.

entry.title: Presenting Symmetrical Flow Matching at AAAI 2026

link.title: Presenting Symmetrical Flow Matching at AAAI 2026

entry.content:
Francisco Caetano presented our work on Symmetrical Flow Matching (SymmFlow) at AAAI 2026.

SymmFlow offers a unified generative framework where generation, segmentation, and classification are treated within one coherent model.

AAAI provided a wonderful setting to exchange ideas with the broader AI community and shape the next steps of this line of research.

Find out more about SymmFlow.

Congratulations to Francisco for representing the TUE ARIA group at AAAI 2026.
entry.summary: Francisco Caetano presented our work on Symmetrical Flow Matching (SymmFlow) at AAAI 2026.

entry.title: Innovative technologies make the industry safer and smarter

link.title: Innovative technologies make the industry safer and smarter

entry.content:
PhD researcher Tim Schoonbeek successfully defended his thesis investigating how AR and AI improve the quality of industrial processes. His research demonstrates how augmented reality combined with artificial intelligence can enhance safety and efficiency in industrial settings.

Congratulations to Dr. Schoonbeek on this significant achievement!
